family_definitions.original: R3B Gaussian ingoing regular spherical wave, r0=5,w=1
family_definitions.wide: R3B single Gaussian, r0=6,w=1.4, historically explored in R3B/R4B1; new amplitudes, not blind family
family_definitions.novel: time-symmetric regular scalar Gaussian shell at r0=5,w=1, Phi from original scalar profile and Pi=0; distinct momentum initial data, no external blindness

scan.policy: fixed scan no search tuning; NEAR_TRAPPING_PROXY threshold .85, not apparent horizon. Endpoint accepted only with both grids same proxy class, full finite history to class event or end, mass and local resolution gates; no assumption any amplitude supercritical. If unresolved/underresolved, no interpolation or bisection; report bracket width only for adjacent confirmed opposing classes, nonmonotonic scan flags. For near-trapping, use full common proper time, report stop time difference and peak overshoot; do not claim full beyond-stop comparison. Independent families not external blind.

convergence.policy: independent amplitude not new family; report nine orders separately, no averaging or explanation of p>2 without evidence; peak compactness and Ricci have distinct tolerances; no new forecast claim

boundary.per_new_amplitude: integrate actual numerical face flux and independently reconstructed interior field flux at r=12; max normalized residual <1% of initial domain mass at both locations; report net outer flux and whether nontrivial (>=25%); if near-vacuum this is not independent outgoing validation
boundary.policy: additional subcritical outgoing controls before scan; no universal boundary certification, actual near-critical outbound propagation can require further test

budget.admit_case: elapsed + projected cost <=3000; projection 4 times prior same-grid cost per doubling or 160 s at 24576, 650 s at 49152, scaled by end/16 and CFL; if budget holds, retain partial results, no changed criteria
budget.priority: boundary, independent triplet and temporal gate, then fixed scan and conditional confirmation of adjacent opposite candidates; no uncontrolled bisection

forbidden: DSS null or period tests including .05
claim_ceiling: Finite proxy bracket only, not established a*, no DSS. Independent amplitude convergence does not prove universality.
